text.en: When a causative verb is used in an imperative addressed to multiple people, the sentence-final particle *yan* can cooccur with a singular verb stem whose semantic causee is singular ⟦claim:valency/causative-morphological-re-e-te--when-a-causative-verb-is-used-in-an⟧. Causative forms combining two personal prefixes, such as **en-e-raykere* (intended 'he makes me kill you'), are unacceptable and unattested in Ainu ⟦claim:valency/causative-morphological-re-e-te--causative-forms-combining-two-personal-prefixes-such-as⟧.
text.ja: 使役動詞が複数人に向けられた命令文で用いられる場合、意味上の被使役者が単数であれば、終助詞*yan*は動詞の単数形語幹と共起できる⟦claim:valency/causative-morphological-re-e-te--when-a-causative-verb-is-used-in-an⟧。**en-e-raykere*（「彼が私にお前を殺させる」の意）のように人称接頭辞が2つ重なる使役形式は容認されず、文献にも見られない⟦claim:valency/causative-morphological-re-e-te--causative-forms-combining-two-personal-prefixes-such-as⟧。
